paper.title: REFLECT: Summarizing Robot Experiences for Failure Explanation and Correction
paper.central_claim: REFLECT summarizes multisensory robot experience hierarchically and queries an LLM progressively to explain and localize failures, and the explanation guides a language planner to correct the failure (RoboFail: 100 sim + 30 real failures).
paper.scope_decision: in_scope: GPT-4 explainer/verifier over a multisensory robot-log harness with explanation-conditioned correction planning executed in AI2THOR.

preliminary_judgment: Written after reading the fixed text, before opening this paper's seat records: system_method (plus RoboFail dataset). Sim: 100 injected failures, ground-truth perception, Exp by human raters, Loc vs annotated ranges, Co-plan executed and goal-checked in AI2THOR; real: 30 teleoperated recordings, explanation/localisation only, no correction run. One pass per case, no variance; Table 5 headers appear to mislabel the real-world row. Expected online, scoped, E.cost not reported, holdout/statistics weak.

signatures.object: post-execution multisensory robot log (RGB-D, audio, robot state) -> three-level text summary (sensory-input scene graph + audio label, event-based key-frame captions, subgoal-end observations)
signatures.information: Full post-hoc log, original robot plan and goal state; sim uses ground-truth detection/state; real uses MDETR/CLIP/AudioCLIP; environment assumed static
signatures.operation: serialize detections, heuristic spatial relations and audio labels into text; select key frames on scene-graph/audio/subgoal change
signatures.conditions: task-relevant objects only; 8 hand-coded spatial relations; fixed state-label lists
signatures.selection_rule_data: key-frame rule: scene-graph change, audio event start/end, subgoal end
signatures.persistence: none (per-episode, not carried to later tasks)
signatures.claimed_effect: more informative explanations than BLIP2 captions / LLM-written summary / no-audio
signatures.failure_boundary: complex scenes beyond heuristics, low-level control failures, dynamic environments, perception errors

signatures.object: progressive failure explanation prompt chain over the summary
signatures.information: subgoal-level text first, event-level history only after a failed subgoal; goal state and original plan for planning-failure branch
signatures.operation: LLM answers Yes/No per subgoal; on No retrieve event summary and ask for explanation; if all Yes ask what is wrong with the plan
signatures.output: failure explanation and failure time step
signatures.conditions: assumes execution vs planning failure dichotomy; in planning mode assumes all actions executed
signatures.feedback: LLM verdicts over text summary (no ground-truth verifier of the Yes/No verdicts reported)
signatures.claimed_effect: higher Exp and Loc than w/o progressive and subgoal-only
signatures.failure_boundary: localization harder for planning failures that are not tied to a single step

signatures.object: explanation-conditioned correction planner (GPT-4) mapped to executable actions by sentence-embedding nearest action
signatures.information: original plan, failure explanation, final state, goal state
signatures.operation: generate correction plan from final state and run it in AI2THOR
signatures.output: correction plan executed; success by goal-state comparison
signatures.failure_boundary: correction not executed on real robot

gap.author_gap: Robots need to explain and correct failures from multimodal logs; prior failure-explanation work handles only specific failure sets and LLM self-reflection works assume ground-truth feedback for one or few actions.
gap.checked_gap: Concrete and sourced from the paper's own related-work text: converting raw multisensory logs into language the LLM can reason over is the bottleneck. Nearest neighbours were not independently fetched (offline), so lineage is as cited by the authors.

gap.residue: Low-level control failures, complex scenes beyond hand-coded relations, dynamic environments, ground-truth perception in simulation, no real-robot correction.

gap.remaining_gap: Real-robot closed-loop correction; non-oracle perception in sim; comparison with published failure-explanation methods; low-level control failures.

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Correction plans are executed in AI2THOR and success is judged by goal-state comparison, but with privileged ground-truth perception; real-world evidence is offline explanation/localisation of teleoperated recordings. No transfer label (no counted real closed-loop recovery). Both seats agree.
assessment.author_claim_preserved: REFLECT summarizes multisensory robot experience hierarchically and queries an LLM progressively to explain and localize failures, and the explanation guides a language planner to correct the failure (RoboFail: 100 sim + 30 real failures).
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: On 100 author-injected AI2THOR failures with ground-truth perception, the GPT-4 hierarchical-summary pipeline gives higher human-judged explanation, localization and goal-checked correction success than in-house ablations; on 30 teleoperated real recordings it explains and localizes better than BLIP2/LLM-summary baselines but ties simple baselines on planning failures.
assessment.cannot_be_claimed: Real-robot autonomous failure correction; robustness with learned perception in simulation; 'wide range of failure scenarios without assumptions on task configuration' beyond the 10+11 author-designed static tasks; a GPT-3.5 vs GPT-4 correction comparison from Table 5.
assessment.reproduction_note: All numbers author-reported; nothing reproduced by us.
assessment.retained: not_applicable: static harness with within-task correction, no persistent accepted improvement

G.reason: Both seats 3. Sourced bottleneck: prior failure explainers cover narrow failure sets and LLM self-reflection assumes ground-truth per-action feedback; nearest neighbours (Socratic-style open QA, Inner-Monologue-style feedback) are reproduced only as in-house ablations, not rerun, so not 4.

M.reason: Both seats 3. Hierarchy plus progressive subgoal verification targets information overload with distinguishable predictions (subgoal-only and LLM-summary should lose cause/time detail, confirmed in Table 1); weak assumptions remain: execution-vs-planning dichotomy, unaudited Yes/No verifier, fixed state vocabulary and static scenes.

X.reason: Both seats 3. Prompts (A.3), spatial/aggregation heuristics (A.1-A.2), retrieval and nearest-action mapping reconstruct the static workflow; information permissions explicit (ground-truth perception in sim). Not 4: key-frame and Yes/No verifier quality unreported, correction execution protocol brief, perception robustness untested.

measurement.reason: Both seats 2. Co-plan uses goal-state truth in simulation but with ground-truth perception; Exp is judged by six raters by majority vote without agreement statistics; per-type denominators only recoverable from percentages; one pass per case; no real-robot correction. Appendix Table 5 additionally relabels the real-world Exp/Loc row as Loc/Co-plan (agg:E001), so the backbone comparison cannot be read as measured correction success. Anchors v2 partial-denominator ceiling 2.

causality.reason: Both seats 3. Same GPT-4 and cases across one-at-a-time ablations (progressive, hierarchy level, summary type, explanation) with w/o explanation as the matched control for correction (41.9/56.1 vs 79.1/80.7). Residual confounds: sound ablated only on real recordings, action mapper not isolated, extra LLM calls unpriced, backbone not crossed with components, real planning rows tie.

holdout.reason: Resolved toward son55 (sol 1). Anchor 2 = development/evaluation overlap: the method and RoboFail share authors and the simulated cases have no stated dev/test split (treated as overlap). The 30 real recordings are a different embodiment and perception stack (MDETR/CLIP/AudioCLIP) on which the explanation/localisation gain over BLIP2/LLM-summary is retained for execution failures, which lifts it above 1; no autonomous physical holdout and real planning rows tie, so not 3.

statistics.reason: Resolved toward son55 (sol 2). Anchors v2: no repeats and no failure decomposition -> <=1; counts without variance -> 1-2. Totals (100 sim, 30 real) and an execution/planning split exist, but per-type denominators are not stated (only inferable as 43/57 and 16/14 from percentages), each case is a single pass, rater agreement is absent and there is no variance or CI. Lower end of the 1-2 band.

cost.reason: Both seats not_reported. No calls, tokens, latency or compute for any method; progressive querying adds calls that are unpriced; GPT-3.5 table is capability, not cost.
search_scope: Full text Sec 1-6 and Appendices A.1-A.3.4, B.1-B.4 (fixed material lines 1-31); searched cost, token, latency, time, calls, compute; only motivation-level remarks about compact summaries.
